scope: Export the estimates at every decision in nine existing registered requests. Verify the reusable inspector against those recorded decisions. No fitted threshold, controller, action set, task definition, or historical score changes.
selection_rule: The first mounting offset and repeat of the existing showcase's RC1 1.5 mm service-loop context, crossed with all three registered error levels and all three registered supervisors. The case set is fixed before capture; every selected case, outcome and decision is kept.
capture_method: The existing routing worker's observer copies the same estimated boot position and insertion axis used on each decision tick. It reads the declared fixture anchor and never calls perception again. It cannot change actions or consume the random stream.
claims: Replay and API parity are software checks, not evidence of a better controller or a new success rate. The full routing study remains the source for performance findings.
budget_units: All three budgets are metres of boot-to-anchor distance. Historical budget unit labels were incorrect; the numerical values are unchanged.

safety_filter.arm: B0plus: the analytic budget carrying a margin sized from the declared estimator covariance
safety_filter.not_refitted: The thresholds come out of the perception study's record unchanged.
safety_filter.fitted_on_single_clip_layouts: The filter was fitted on single-clip layouts and has never seen a five-clip cell. That is not a confound to be removed; it is the deployment situation the study is about, and it is declared here so the result is read as what it is - a shipped check applied to a longer chain in new geometry.

loaded_at_freeze.kind: analytic budget with a measurement-robust margin
loaded_at_freeze.shape_matched_status: off; this is the registered baseline
loaded_at_freeze.scope: Fitted on one task, one connector and one cable model, in simulation. The thresholds are properties of that. No hardware, no force-certified safety claim, and no guarantee outside the registered action space.

compare: job failure reason, elapsed time, held seating and route completion
all issued action indices, abstentions, motion completion and request acceptance
all chosen magnitudes, endpoint distances, headrooms and budget arithmetic
zero privilege and mutation guard events
inspector policy action parity on each captured estimate
